purpose: build the database objects and data access layer that the application needs, safely and testably
entry_criteria: Development database and migration tooling exist
procedure: Write schema changes as versioned, repeatable migrations in source control; never edit the database by hand.
Prefer additive, backward-compatible changes so old and new code run against the same schema.
Implement queries with parameters, explicit columns and tested access paths; avoid building SQL from strings.
Test migrations on a copy with realistic data, forward and where possible backward, and record the duration.
Check query plans for the main queries and add indexes where needed.
Review with the database administrator before the change goes toward production (stage 132).
acceptance_criteria: Every change is a versioned migration
Migration ran on realistic data with duration recorded

validation.command: alembic upgrade head && alembic downgrade -1 && alembic upgrade head   # example migration tool
validation.expect: all three succeed on a fresh database
no SQL built by string formatting

failure_modes.mode: Manual change in a shared database

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A migration adds a nullable column and an index concurrently. It runs up, down and up again on a fresh database, takes two minutes on a production-size copy, and the main query plan uses the new index.
